overview:
**Fire danger is High today across the Montrose (High Elevation) zone, driven by dry fuels and building ERC/BI levels that push toward Very High by midweek.**
- Danger rises to Very High Wednesday–Friday (Sep 10–12) before easing back to High next Sunday.
- Winds shift from ENE to more northerly (N–NNE) later this week, with humidity dropping into the high-teens by Wednesday.
- No Red Flag Warning is in effect; all 7 local watchout thresholds are currently unmet.
- Stage 1 Fire Restrictions are active in unincorporated Montrose County, effective since September 4, and Stage 1 restrictions also remain in place across the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests. Stage 1 Fire Restrictions are in effect in unincorporated Montrose County starting on 09/04/2026.
- The Elk Fire, burning in Hinsdale/Gunnison County backcountry within the Gunnison National Forest, is holding at 7,257 acres and 73% contained, per the latest interagency situation report.
- A slight uptick in weekend moisture (0.03"–0.06") may offer brief relief late in the week.
